### 1 — Scene
A hot meal of pasta in reddish sauce, browned meat strips (likely chicken), and roasted potatoes, with a separate bowl of mixed fruit. There is also a glass of water.

### 2 — Vessels
- **Main plate:** approximately 24 cm diameter; area = 3.14 × 12² = **452 cm²**.
- **Fruit bowl:** approximately 20 cm diameter; area = 3.14 × 10² = **314 cm²**.

### 3 — Items
Pasta with tomato-based sauce, browned meat strips, roasted potato halves, watermelon, apple, strawberry, and a little orange-colored fruit, likely orange. Visible sauce and cooking fat are included in the prepared foods’ energy estimates.

### 4–7 — Area, volume, weight, and energy
Coverage percentages refer to each item’s own vessel. Volume is the pile’s outer envelope; bulk density is the only adjustment for gaps.

| Item | Vessel coverage | Area × height = volume | Density | Weight | kcal/100 g | Energy |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Pasta with sauce | 43% | 194 × 1.4 = 272 ml | 0.80 | 218 g | 170 | 371 kcal |
| Browned meat strips | 12% | 54 × 1.1 = 59 ml | 0.95 | 57 g | 190 | 108 kcal |
| Roasted potatoes | 22% | 99 × 1.8 = 178 ml | 0.70 | 125 g | 110 | 138 kcal |
| Watermelon | 32% | 100 × 2.0 = 200 ml | 0.60 | 120 g | 30 | 36 kcal |
| Apple pieces | 9% | 28 × 1.8 = 50 ml | 0.60 | 30 g | 52 | 16 kcal |
| Strawberry pieces | 6% | 19 × 1.3 = 25 ml | 0.60 | 15 g | 32 | 5 kcal |
| Orange pieces | 2% | 6 × 1.3 = 8 ml | 0.60 | 5 g | 47 | 2 kcal |

**Coverage check:** main plate **77%**; fruit bowl **49%**. Both are consistent with the visible food footprints.

### 8 — Sanity check
Approximately **570 g of food and 775 kcal** is plausible for the substantial main plate plus a modest fruit bowl. The meat identification and amount of cooking oil are the largest uncertainties. Water is excluded from the food weight.
